senses.gloss: m. pl. (דקק, with prefixed ה a. נ inserted; corresp. to h. גַּדְגַּדְנִיּוֹת) melilot, a kind of clover used as a relish.—
units: <cite ref="Eruvin 28a:10">Erub. 28ᵃ</cite> <he>ה׳ מדאי</he> Median Melilot. Y. ib. III, 20ᵈ top; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Peah 8:4:4">Y. Peah VIII, 21ᵃ</cite> top.
